metric_definitions.newly discovered producer defects: Producer exceptions or positive records that violate their typed-output contract; guarded abstentions are not defects.
metric_definitions.projection conflicts: Rows where a generated producer/view surface conflicts with the canonical source surface.
metric_definitions.reconstruction failures: Rows with failed source or typed-producer reconstruction.
metric_definitions.rows generating at-rest projection: Rows whose source segments are owned and concatenate exactly to the canonical surface.
metric_definitions.rows generating both compact and expande: Rows with a fact-derived payload exposing one payload identity through compact and expanded views.
metric_definitions.rows generating rich Naḥw: Rows with a positive typed local/F-C naḥw view that is N-LANG-clean.
metric_definitions.rows generating rich Ṣarf: Rows with a positive F-B fact-derived Ṣarf view that is N-LANG-clean.
metric_definitions.rows with both: Rows satisfying both complete-fact predicates after the bounded merge.
metric_definitions.rows with complete morphology facts: Rows with an existing structured morphology carrier or a positive guarded F-B clitic-composition fact.
metric_definitions.rows with complete naḥw facts: Rows with an existing structured naḥw carrier or a positive guarded F-C dependency fact.
metric_definitions.rows with repeated-appearance parity: Rows whose exact location has a unique merged occurrence record with two or more appearances and a stable projection hash.
metric_definitions.source/scholar queues: Source and scholar queue counts; all verified candidate rows remain scholar-routed, while source counts identify input/producer/structural follow-up.
metric_definitions.unresolved rows by exact blocker: Counts of row blockers by exact stable blocker code or producer selector reason.

movement.interpretation: Movement measures this calibrated 455-row candidate rerun only; it is not corpus-wide certification or live coverage.

stats.source: merged occurrence index built in memory from explicit corpus and entries paths

scope.nahw_condition: F-C applies only when its exact source-evidence selector and strict contract builder accept
scope.other_families: prior state retained; no scope creep
